title: TI P4-06: create the new CMS app from the template, GitHub App connect, first build, release-gate checks
description:
## Goal
A NEW Threat Intelligence CMS app (WEB_COMPUTE, Pretext public site + /newsroom in one app) created from the template, connected to the repo with the Amplify GitHub App, first build green on its default amplifyapp.com URL, release-gate checks passed. No domain yet. Mirrors Pilobol.us P3-04 (PPY-97f03c) minus the reader app: a Pretext site has no separate reader app (examples/pretext.site.json has no reader block).

## Context (FACT)
- Pilobol lessons (docs/site-hosting.md, "Verify and repair after connecting"): the console GitHub connect can flip platform to WEB, replace the service role with amplifyconsole-backend-role, and DELETE the stack's branches and their environment variables (observed 2026-10-06). Repair: update-app --platform WEB_COMPUTE and --iam-service-role-arn; re-create branches; re-apply env vars by a stack update that changes the branch variables (CloudFormation does not see the loss as drift).
- Prereqs: scaffold PR merged into the TI repo main (P4-04), template change merged and published (P4-05), an @anthusai/papyrus next version containing both pins.
- The new Cognito domain prefix papyrus-threat-intelligence must differ from the old pool's auto-generated domain b1f1d3a11a4545ba5318 (old pool us-east-1_lAtce7ZTu stays until retire).
- Release gates to check from the Pilobol list: schema gate (new backend has bodyMarkus, bodyIr, aliases on Item and PublishedItem); brand gate (unknown brand id fails a scratch build; PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND and NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND equal threat-intelligence); nodejs middleware works on WEB_COMPUTE (pages, /newsroom, robots).
- Secrets exist today as SSM params under /amplify/d3on1y5vlrxmam/main-branch-aeb7dfa526/: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET (the JWT authorizer was removed from develop; the new backend uses IAM, so PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET is not recreated).

## Exact steps
1. Ryan: aws sso login --profile legacy; yes to deploying the new stack (npx papyrus-infra synth, review cdk diff, cdk deploy from infra/ with AWS_PROFILE=legacy). Record AppId output.
2. Ryan, console sitting: install the AWS Amplify GitHub App on AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence (add the repository to the existing org install), connect the new app to repository AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence branch main using the template's existing service role, no new role.
3. Run aws amplify get-app and list-branches before and after; apply the repairs above if drifted; re-deploy the stack to re-apply branch env vars; start the first build; wait for the backend pipeline-deploy and frontend build to succeed.
4. Gate checks (read-only probes and a scratch build): the three gates above; GET the default URL home (redirects to the edition path), /newsroom, and a missing path returns the 404 page.
5. Record names of env vars only (never values).

## Acceptance checks
- aws amplify get-app shows platform WEB_COMPUTE, the template service role, repository AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence; list-branches shows main with the env var NAMES from site.json plus SITE_ENV, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE.
- Job status SUCCEED for branch main; new AppSync API exists with the schema gate satisfied; new Cognito pool has domain papyrus-threat-intelligence.
- The default URL serves the Pretext site shell (empty edition acceptable until P4-09) and /newsroom.
- Old app untouched (list-jobs unchanged, still serving).

## Rollback
Delete the new stack (Ryan deletes); the old app is unaffected.

## Risks
Python 3.12 on Amplify is not needed for a Pretext cms spec (it only runs npm and ampx), so the Pilobol risk does not apply here; the backend build still bundles Python Lambdas from papyrus-newsroom==<pin> and is first exercised here. Build compute: the old app needed no special size; Pilobol used STANDARD_8GB (cms.buildComputeType).

## Needs Ryan
Yes: SSO login, stack deploy yes, console GitHub App sitting (step 2).

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.

comments.text:
P4-06 PREPARATION (2026-10-07, read-only; no AWS write, no deploy, no merge to main). Nothing below has been executed except reads.

## A. Branch strategy: how to run the new app's builds without main

Facts checked:
- Template (lib/amplify-app-shell.ts on origin/develop): the production CfnBranch is hard-coded branchName "main" (stage PRODUCTION, owns the backend); only the READER has a branchName option (reader.branchName). site-config.ts has no cms.branchName key and rejects unknown cms keys. The staging build spec runs `ampx generate outputs --branch main`; domains map branch "main". So the template assumes Amplify branch main = Git main.
- Amplify: an Amplify branch IS a Git branch (create-branch --branch-name is the Git ref name; the console connect step picks a Git branch and creates the Amplify branch of that name). There is no field mapping an Amplify branch to a differently named Git branch. And the backend is per Amplify branch: `ampx pipeline-deploy --branch $AWS_BRANCH` creates stack amplify-<appId>-<branch>-branch-<hash> (new API, new Cognito pool, new tables per branch name).
- Old app d3on1y5vlrxmam (read now): WEB_COMPUTE, repo https://github.com/anthusai/threat-intelligence, clone method TOKEN (PAT), one branch main, enableAutoBuild TRUE, productionBranch main (last deploy 2026-08-29), no manual webhooks. Its pasted build spec runs `npm install` then `npx ampx pipeline-deploy --debug --branch $AWS_BRANCH --app-id $AWS_APP_ID`: any build of the NEW scaffold on its main would run pipeline-deploy of the new backend code against the OLD backend stack (schema and resource changes on the old API). It must never build the scaffold.
- TI repo heads: develop, feature/PPY-504020-packages-scaffold, scaffold/packages (PR #10 base), cursor/*, epic/*. The old app only watches main.

Options:
(a) Amplify main tracks Git scaffold/packages: IMPOSSIBLE (no mapping; template hard-codes main).
(b) Amplify branch named scaffold/packages: possible, but (1) template emits branch main only, so after the console connect (which deletes the stack's branches and their env vars) the connected scaffold/packages branch has NO env vars and the stack cannot re-apply them (CloudFormation owns main, not scaffold/packages): needs manual `aws amplify update-branch --environment-variables` writes, brittle; (2) its backend is a separate stack/API/Cognito pool from a later `main` one, so everything proven or copied (P4-07 admin, P4-08/09 copy) would be thrown away and redone at cutover, or scaffold/packages would have to become the production branch forever (staging build spec, domain mapping and docs all say main). Fine only as a disposable first-build rehearsal; costs Ryan a second console sitting.
(c) Disable auto build on the old app, merge scaffold to Git main early: works, single backend lineage (main), matches P4-04 (Ryan: disable old app auto-build first). The old app keeps serving its last good deployment (domain, Cognito, API unaffected). Residual risk: a manual start-job on the old app, or someone re-enabling auto build, would run pipeline-deploy from scaffold main against the old backend. Needs Ryan's go (main merge + old-app change).
(d) New repo: not needed; rejected by decision 2 and only safe-vs-(c) in that the old app could never see it.
(e) Hybrid: do the no-risk half of P4-06 now with the domain-free stack (no Git yet), merge to main only at the last responsible moment (see B).

RECOMMENDATION: (c), after an explicit Ryan go, with the old-app guard first and the merge second. Until the go, nothing can be built (no Git connection) but everything else is ready: stack deploy, role/secret prep, Google URIs.

Rollback for (c) (ordered):
1. Before anything: record `git rev-parse origin/main` (old tip 9058211 per assessment) and `git tag pre-standard-fork 9058211` (push tag, Ryan or on his yes). Record old app state: `aws amplify get-branch --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --branch-name main` and `aws amplify list-jobs --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --branch-name main --max-items 3`.
2. Guard (Ryan yes): `aws amplify update-branch --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --branch-name main --no-enable-auto-build`. Verify `get-branch ... --query branch.enableAutoBuild` is false.
3. Merge PR #10 (feature -> scaffold/packages) then scaffold/packages -> main (Ryan merges). Verify no new job: `aws amplify list-jobs --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --branch-name main --max-items 1` unchanged; `curl -sI https://threat-intelligence.anth.us/2026/july/04` still 200; old API untouched.
4. Rollback: new app: delete stack (see section 4). Git: `git revert -m 1 <merge sha>` PR to main (never force-push) or restore from tag; only after main is back to the old tree, `aws amplify update-branch --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --branch-name main --enable-auto-build`. Old app never changed otherwise.
Optional extra guard (reversible, recommend only if Ryan wants belt and braces): `aws amplify update-branch --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --branch-name main --build-spec 'version: 1
frontend:
  phases:
    build:
      commands:
        - exit 1
  artifacts:
    baseDirectory: .
    files: [x]'` so an accidental job fails before pipeline-deploy; restore with `--build-spec ''` is NOT equivalent (app-level spec is the console-pasted one), so prefer not to.

## B. Domain trap in the repo's infra/site.json (affects P4-06)
infra/site.json on the scaffold sets cms.domainName anth.us + domainPrefix threat-intelligence + stagingDomainPrefix: synth emits ONE AWS::Amplify::Domain (anth.us; prefixes main->threat-intelligence, staging->threat-intelligence-staging) which would try to claim the production host from the old app at stack create (that is P4-11, not P4-06). For P4-06 deploy a domain-free copy (no hostedZoneId, no domainName/domainPrefix/stagingDomainPrefix, cms.staging false); synthesized and checked: App threat-intelligence-cms WEB_COMPUTE, ONE branch main with env names PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_CONSOLE_RESPONDER, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_SLACK, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_INBOUND_EMAIL, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_STORAGE_BACKUPS, PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS, PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX, PAPYRUS_APPLY_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, SITE_ENV, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE, PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET_PARAMETER; zero Domain resources; roles: service, compute, authoring, github-ci (GitHub OIDC provider already exists in the account). The full site.json is deployed later (stack update) at P4-11. Note: the template sets PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND only (the app resolves NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND ?? PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND), so the ticket's "NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND" check is satisfied by the build-time capture of PAPYRUS_ env, not a branch variable: check PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND = threat-intelligence. A scratch copy of the domain-free file is at /private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-home-Projects/f48eecf1-1905-4a55-ae79-973fb25835bd/scratchpad/site.p406.json (will be regenerated by `python3` from infra/site.json: remove hostedZoneId, cms.domainName, cms.domainPrefix, cms.stagingDomainPrefix; set cms.staging false).

## C. Scaffold pin bump (done)
Latest: npm dist-tag next = 1.0.0-next.21 (PyPI papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev21). next.20 did NOT contain lib/brand-fonts-watch (published 16:12Z, before #155/#154); next.21 tarball contains lib/brand-fonts-watch.ts, lib/revalidate-secret.ts, lib/video-script.ts (checked by npm pack). Pushed to feature/PPY-504020-packages-scaffold: commit 859fd2b (package.json, package-lock.json, infra/site.json papyrusVersion 1.0.0-next.19 -> 1.0.0-next.21; the build spec derives papyrus-newsroom==1.0.0.dev21 from it). PR #10 (base scaffold/packages) head is 859fd2b. In a fresh shallow clone: `npm ci` OK; `npx papyrus-infra synth --site infra/site.json` OK (full site, 1 Domain with 2 sub-domain settings) and domain-free variant OK; `npm test` 2 pass 0 fail. `npm run typecheck` reports only TS2307 'papyrus-amplify-outputs' (amplify_outputs.json is generated by the first backend deploy: expected offline). Clone deleted.

## D. STEP LIST

### 1. Orchestrator (needs Ryan's yes in chat for each AWS write)
1a. (Ryan) `aws sso login --profile legacy`.
1b. Fresh clone, domain-free site file (NOT committed): `git clone --depth 5 -b feature/PPY-504020-packages-scaffold https://github.com/AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence /Users/home/Projects/TI-p406 && cd /Users/home/Projects/TI-p406 && npm ci --ignore-scripts && python3 (edit as in B) > /Users/home/Projects/TI-p406/infra/site.p406.json`. Record BEFORE state: `aws amplify list-apps` (expect no threat-intelligence-cms) and `aws cloudformation list-stacks` (no amplify-app-shell-threat-intelligence-cms).
1c. Review: `cd infra && npx papyrus-infra synth --site site.p406.json` and `AWS_PROFILE=legacy npx aws-cdk@2 diff --app 'node cdk.out' ...` (new stack: expect all-create; diff against nothing is the review). Show Ryan resource list: 1 App, 1 Branch main, 4 roles (+policies), no Domain.
1d. DEPLOY (needs yes): from infra/: `AWS_PROFILE=legacy npx aws-cdk@2 deploy --app cdk.out AmplifyAppShell-threat-intelligence --require-approval broadening` (or the repo's papyrus-infra deploy wrapper if present in next.21: check `npx papyrus-infra --help`; the ticket's `SITE=infra/site.json npm run deploy` is the Papyrus-repo form and does not exist in the publication repo). Record AppId, service role ARN, compute role ARN, authoring role ARN from outputs.
1e. Record the pre-connect state for later diff: `aws amplify get-app --app-id <id> --query 'app.{platform:platform,serviceRole:iamServiceRoleArn,compute:computeRoleArn,repo:repository}'` and `aws amplify list-branches --app-id <id> --query 'branches[].[branchName,environmentVariables]'` (names only in the record).
1f. After Ryan's console connect (section 2): diff get-app; repair with (needs yes): `aws amplify update-app --app-id <id> --platform WEB_COMPUTE`, `aws amplify update-app --app-id <id> --iam-service-role-arn <template service role arn>`; re-create branch main if missing (the connect creates it); re-apply env vars by a stack update that changes the branch variables (e.g. add a harmless PAPYRUS_STACK_REAPPLY marker in the domain-free site file, deploy, then remove it): CloudFormation does not see the loss as drift. Re-check list-branches env names.
1g. Start/monitor the first build (needs yes): `aws amplify start-job --app-id <id> --branch-name main --job-type RELEASE` (or let the connect's own first job run); `aws amplify get-job ... --query job.summary.status` until SUCCEED.
1h. Gates and probes (read-only), then record names only. Delete TI-p406 clone and node_modules when done.

### 2. Ryan by hand
2a. Pre-reqs (Ryan merge sequence from A): old-app guard command (step A2), merge PR #10 into scaffold/packages, scaffold/packages into main. Without this nothing can build.
2b. AWS Console > Amplify > All apps > threat-intelligence-cms > Hosting > Connect repository > GitHub > Continue > in the pop-up: AWS Amplify GitHub App > install/authorize for org AnthusAI, Only select repositories = AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence (add it to the existing install) > repository AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence, branch `main` > Next. When the wizard offers a service role, pick the EXISTING template role (named amplify-app-shell-threat-intelligence-cms-AmplifyServiceRole...), not Create new. Do nothing else (no env vars, no build settings edits) > Save and deploy. Tell me when done (it starts a first job: expected to fail or succeed, either way I re-check).
2c. Google (P4-07, can be done any time after 1d): in Google Cloud project 94722830066, OAuth client ...7pf0ui44...: Authorized JavaScript origins add `https://papyrus-threat-intelligence.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com`; Authorized redirect URIs add `https://papyrus-threat-intelligence.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse`. (The old pool's domain b1f1d3a11a4545ba5318 is separate; do not remove its URIs.)
2d. SSM secrets for the main backend branch, after the connect and first backend deploy (the path has the hash; compute it): `APP=<appId>; H=$(printf '%s' "${APP}main" | shasum -a 512 | cut -c1-10); echo $H` then:
`read -rs GID; AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws ssm put-parameter --region us-east-1 --name /amplify/$APP/main-branch-$H/GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID --type SecureString --value "$GID" --overwrite; unset GID`
`read -rs GSECRET; AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws ssm put-parameter --region us-east-1 --name /amplify/$APP/main-branch-$H/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET --type SecureString --value "$GSECRET" --overwrite; unset GSECRET`
(Verify the path first with `aws ssm describe-parameters --parameter-filters Key=Name,Option=BeginsWith,Values=/amplify/$APP/` after the first build creates the branch; if the first backend build fails for missing secrets, the pipeline creates the placeholders. Hash rule: first 10 hex of sha512(appId + branchName).) Then redeploy: ask me to start-job RELEASE on main.
2e. Revalidate secret (Pretext: SSM, not a variant): `AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws ssm put-parameter --region us-east-1 --name /papyrus/threat-intelligence/revalidate-secret --type SecureString --value "$(openssl rand -hex 32)"` (never reuse the old PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET value; do not echo).

### 3. Verification after (read-only)
- get-app: platform WEB_COMPUTE; iamServiceRoleArn = template role (not amplifyconsole-backend-role); repository https://github.com/AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence; computeRoleArn set.
- list-branches: main with env names listed in B; no staging (staging false) until P4-10.
- get-job: status SUCCEED for main (backend pipeline-deploy AND frontend build in the log; no ampx error).
- Backend: new stack `amplify-<appId>-main-branch-<hash>` exists; new AppSync API (`aws appsync list-graphql-apis`); schema gate: `aws appsync get-introspection-schema --api-id <new> --format SDL /dev/stdout | grep -E 'bodyMarkus|bodyIr|aliases'` appears on Item and PublishedItem; new pool with `aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool --user-pool-id <new pool> --query UserPool.Domain` = papyrus-threat-intelligence (differs from old b1f1d3a11a4545ba5318; old pool lAtce7ZTu untouched); Google IdP present after 2c/2d.
- Brand gate: PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND = threat-intelligence on the branch; scratch build with unknown brand id fails: in a throwaway clone `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=nope npm run build` must fail with "Unknown brand 'nope'"; no Amplify job needed.
- Prod gate: `curl -sI https://main.<appId>.amplifyapp.com/` redirects to the edition path (empty edition acceptable until P4-09); `/newsroom` 200 (sign-in); `/robots.txt` answers; a missing path returns the 404 page (nodejs middleware on WEB_COMPUTE).
- Old app untouched: list-jobs on d3on1y5vlrxmam unchanged, https://threat-intelligence.anth.us serves, old stack amplify-d3on1y5vlrxmam-main-branch-aeb7dfa526 no UPDATE events.
- Baseline comparison (after P4-09 content, otherwise only shell checks): copy /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/threat-intelligence-20261007/capture_site.py to a scratch dir, change BASE to the new default URL (capture_site.py does only HTTP + playwright, no AWS), run with the baseline venv `.venv/bin/python capture_site.py OUT_DIR` (120 screenshots = 20 routes x 3 widths x 2 schemes); diff site/routes.json and text hashes against baseline/site/; screenshot PNG hashes are informational only. Models/S3 parts of run_all.sh need SSO and point at the OLD backend: re-point export_models.py to the new API (P4-09).

### 4. Rollback
- New app: Ryan deletes the stack `amplify-app-shell-threat-intelligence-cms` (`aws cloudformation delete-stack ...` on his yes); then the backend stack amplify-<appId>-main-branch-<hash> (created by ampx outside the app-shell stack; delete via the app, or `aws amplify delete-app --app-id <id>` which removes the branch; confirm the nested stacks and the Cognito pool are gone); delete stray amplifyconsole-backend-role and the SSM params under /amplify/<appId>/ and /papyrus/threat-intelligence/ ; remove the Google URIs added in 2c.
- Git/old app: per A.4 (revert merge on main by PR, then re-enable auto build; tag pre-standard-fork is the recovery point). The old app, its backend and domain are never modified by this plan except the reversible auto-build flag.
